description.fun: Buizel wears its own life ring: the yellow collar around its neck is a flotation sac it inflates to bob along with its head above water, watching for prey, and deflates to dive. Underwater it spins its two tails like a boat's propeller, which also slices through clinging seaweed. Its name is buoy plus weasel, and Ken Sugimori's first artwork of it left out one of its paw pads.
description.guide: Buizel is a Water-type Pokémon resembling a weasel and a sea otter. It inflates the flotation sac around its neck to float and spins its two tails to swim. It evolves into Floatzel.
description.tagline: A sea weasel with a built-in life ring and propeller tails.

description.fun: Floatzel's flotation sac has grown into a long ring around its body, developed from chasing prey through the water, and it keeps Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. It is a common sight around fishing ports, where it rescues drowning people by carrying them like a rubber raft and helps fishers carry their catch. Its name mixes float and weasel, with a hint of flotsam.
description.guide: Floatzel is the evolved form of Buizel. Its large flotation sac lets it float in rough seas and carry people on its back like a raft, and it is known for rescuing people and helping out at fishing ports.
description.tagline: A lifeguard otter that doubles as a raft.
